text: Tameeni is Rasan Information Technology's insurance platform: Rasan's 2024 IPO prospectus lists Tameeni Electronic Insurance Brokerage Limited as wholly owned by the company. The IPO offered 30% of Rasan's shares on the Saudi Exchange's main market in May 2024.
short: Tameeni is wholly owned by Rasan, which floated 30% on the Saudi Exchange in 2024.

source.note: Subsidiaries chapter of the prospectus (p. 16 of the PDF): 'Tameeni Electronic Insurance Brokerage Limited, a limited liability company established and existing in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia under Commercial Registration No. 1010838913, ... wholly owned by the Company (hereinafter referred to as Tameeni Company)'. The substantial-shareholders table on the same page lists Impact46 funds and private individuals.
